title: Part A: Min-Max Continual-RL Consolidation
subtitle: Constrained two-policy consolidation, experts NOT stored (config ppo.method = constrained).

sections.text: Tasks $1,\dots,K$ arrive in sequence. A single shared-trunk, multi-head GLOBAL policy $\pi_G=\pi_\phi$ must keep performing on every seen task. Nothing about the past is stored except the current parameters $\phi$: past-task quantities are re-estimated by FRESH rollouts in the old environments each iteration (replay-free). NO per-task expert model is saved; the current task's floor is supplied on the fly by a throwaway LOCAL policy trained from scratch.

Each stage $k\ge 2$ runs a three-checkpoint local-global cycle (eq 4): $\pi_G^-\to\pi_L\to\pi_G^+$. Here $\pi_G^-=\pi_{\phi^-}$ is the previous global (held FIXED all stage); $\pi_L$ is a local specialist trained by plain PPO on task $k$ from $\theta^{(0)}=\phi^-$ (eqs 5, 19), then FROZEN, whose value $\hat V_k^L$ is the current-task floor; and $\pi_G^+=\pi_{\phi^*}$ is the consolidated global, produced by maximizing the weighted past objective $\sum_{i<k}\omega_i V_i^\phi$ subject to the one-sided current-task floor, enforced as a primal-dual saddle over $(\phi,\mu)$. At stage end $\phi^-\leftarrow\phi^*$ and task $k$ joins the past set (eq 6). Only the ACTOR carries the constraint; the critic, GAE, value-MSE and entropy are ordinary shared-trunk PPO (Algorithm 1).

sections.name: $\mathrm{run}$  (method = constrained)
inputs: ordered family of $K$ tasks (Atari games), each with a greedy threshold
dual controller (projected ascent): $\mu$ init, step $\eta$, ceiling $\mu_{\max}$; tolerance $\varepsilon$
outputs: final global policy $\to$ final\_policy.pt; per-task checkpoints global\_after\_task$k$.pt, local\_after\_task$k$.pt

body.text: STAGE 1 (plain PPO on the global net):  LocalTrainer.train$(\pi_\phi,\ \mathrm{task}_1,\ \mathrm{task1\_iters})$
record its greedy score as task 1's local reference (no local phase, no floor, no $\mu$)
$\mathrm{row}_1 \leftarrow$ evaluate-row$(1)$;  append to eval-matrix;  save progress
for $k = 2,\dots,K$ do
constrained-task$(k)$
$\mathrm{row}_k \leftarrow$ evaluate-row$(k)$;  append to eval-matrix;  save progress
end for
save eval-matrix and final\_policy $=\phi^*$

sections.name: constrained-task$(k)$   (one local-global cycle)
inputs: task $k$; past tasks $\{1,\dots,k-1\}$; global policy $\pi_\phi$ (parameters $\phi^-$ carried in)

body.text: for $\mathrm{cycle} = 1,\dots,\mathrm{cycles\_per\_task}$ do
LOCAL PHASE  (produce the frozen floor $\hat V_k^L$; eqs 5, 18-23):
$\pi_L \leftarrow$ clone$(\pi_\phi,\ \mathrm{trainable})$   ($\theta^{(0)}=\phi^-$)
LocalTrainer.train$(\pi_L,\ \mathrm{task}_k,\ \mathrm{local\_iters})$   (plain PPO); then FREEZE $\bar\pi_L$
save $\bar\pi_L\to$ local\_after\_task$k$.pt   ($\bar\pi_L$ IS Part A's per-task reference)
$\hat V_k^L \leftarrow$ eval-value$(\bar\pi_L,\ \mathrm{task}_k)$   (on-policy STOCHASTIC MC return; the floor)
GLOBAL PHASE  (constrained consolidation; eqs 25-48):
$\mu$-controller.reset()   (fresh dual per phase: $\mu\leftarrow$ init unless warm-started)
$\omega \leftarrow [\,1/k\,]$ repeated $k-1$ times   (uniform past weights $\omega_i=1/k$)
GlobalTrainer.train$(\pi_\phi,\ \mathrm{task}_k,\ \mathrm{past},\ \hat V_k^L,\ \mathrm{dual},\ \omega,\ \varepsilon,\ \mathrm{global\_iters})$
($\bar\pi_L$ passed only for KL-gap logging / optional BC term)
log the current-task reference $\hat V_k^L$
end for

sections.text: Local player: plain PPO on one task

The local player is standard PPO with a single rollout stream and actor coefficient $1$ (eqs 18-23); the coeff-sum normalization inside Algorithm 1 is therefore a no-op here. It early-stops when the greedy game score meets the task threshold $\mathrm{patience}$ times.

sections.name: LocalTrainer.train$(\pi,\ \mathrm{task},\ \mathrm{num\_iters})$
inputs: policy $\pi$; task; iteration cap; greedy threshold $\tau_\mathrm{thr}$
outputs: trained $\pi$ (best-greedy snapshot kept if a late phase diverges)

body.text: $\mathrm{opt}\leftarrow$ Adam;  collector $\leftarrow$ one rollout stream on task
for $\mathrm{it}=1,\dots,\mathrm{num\_iters}$ do
$\mathrm{batch}\leftarrow$ collect$(\pi)$ with GAE
optimize-batches$(\pi,\ \mathrm{opt},\ [\mathrm{batch}],\ [\,1\,])$   (Algorithm 1)
periodically: greedy score; EARLY STOP once score $\ge \tau_\mathrm{thr}$ for patience checks
end for

sections.text: The global player maximizes $\sum_{i<k}\omega_i V_i^\phi$ (eq 25) while a single multiplier $\mu$ enforces the floor $V_k^G\ge \hat V_k^L$ through the one-sided squared hinge $F_k=[\hat V_k^L-\hat V_k^G]_+^2\le\varepsilon$ (eqs 26, 27). The current task's actor coefficient is the differentiated hinge $2\mu[\hat V_k^L-\hat V_k^G]_+$ (eqs 38, 40). The value $\hat V_k^G$ is a FRESH on-policy Monte-Carlo estimate (never read off the moving critic head), refreshed on a SLOW dual timescale.

sections.name: GlobalTrainer.train$(\pi_\phi,\ \mathrm{task}_k,\ \mathrm{past},\ \hat V_k^L,\ \mathrm{dual},\ \omega,\ \varepsilon,\ \mathrm{num\_iters})$
inputs: global $\pi_\phi$; frozen floor $\hat V_k^L$; past weights $\omega_i=1/k$; tolerance $\varepsilon$

body.text: $\mathrm{opt}\leftarrow$ Adam;  one persistent replay-free collector per task (all past + current)
$\mu\leftarrow$ dual.value;  $s_k\leftarrow 0$;  $F_k\leftarrow 0$;  $\hat V_k^G\leftarrow$ NaN
for $\mathrm{it}=1,\dots,\mathrm{num\_iters}$ do
(1) FRESH rollouts, past + current, this iteration (replay-free):
if past-sampling = sample: pick one random past task $j$; roll only it,
with coeff $\omega_j\cdot n_\mathrm{past}$ (unbiased estimate of the full past sum)
else: roll ALL past tasks $i<k$, each with coeff $\omega_i=1/k$
cur-batch $\leftarrow$ collect(task $k$)
(2) SLOW dual timescale: every $\mathrm{constraint\_every}$ iterations do:
$\hat V_k^G \leftarrow$ fresh on-policy Monte-Carlo value of $\pi_\phi$ on task $k$ (eq 42)
$s_k \leftarrow \max(0,\ \hat V_k^L-\hat V_k^G)$   ($[\hat V_k^L-\hat V_k^G]_+$);   $F_k \leftarrow s_k^2$   (eq 26)
$\mu \leftarrow$ dual.update$(F_k,\ \varepsilon)$   (projected dual ascent, eq 47)
$\mathrm{coeff}_k \leftarrow \mu\cdot 2\cdot s_k$   (differentiated hinge, eqs 38, 40; held fixed between refreshes)
(3) one PPO update over ALL streams (past first, current last):
streams $\leftarrow$ past-batches $+\ [\,$cur-batch$\,]$;   coeffs $\leftarrow$ past-coeffs $+\ [\,\mathrm{coeff}_k\,]$
optimize-batches$(\pi_\phi,\ \mathrm{opt},\ \mathrm{streams},\ \mathrm{coeffs},\ \mathrm{kl\_stop}=\mathrm{false})$   (Algorithm 1)
early-stop check (default: current game hits its greedy threshold; V5: every
seen task $\ge$ retention frac of its local reference)
end for
return $\pi_{\phi^+} \leftarrow \pi_\phi$

sections.name: ProjectedAscentDual.update$(F_k,\ \varepsilon)$   (eq 47)
inputs: current-task squared shortfall $F_k$; tolerance $\varepsilon$; step $\eta$; ceiling $\mu_{\max}$

body.text: $\mu \leftarrow \mathrm{clip}\left(\mu + \eta\,(F_k - \varepsilon),\ 0,\ \mu_{\max}\right)$;   return $\mu$
lower clip at 0 is the $[\cdot]_+$ projection of eq 47; the upper cap $\mu_{\max}$ is a magnitude-only deviation

sections.name: evaluate-row$(k)$   (post-task greedy forgetting row)
inputs: global $\pi_\phi$; seen tasks $1,\dots,k$ (or all $K$ if eval-all-tasks)
outputs: row $[\mathrm{score}_1,\dots,\mathrm{score}_k]$ of the forgetting matrix (+ per-game std)

body.text: for each seen task $i$: score $\leftarrow$ reported GREEDY (argmax) game SCORE of $\pi_\phi$
pooled over fixed-seed episodes (exact greedy via no-op enumeration if enabled)
reported metric is task PERFORMANCE (raw score), NOT the discounted value $V$

sections.text: Faithful practical deviations from the raw equations

D1 (coeff-sum normalization, Algorithm 1): every actor coefficient is divided by their sum before the PPO step. This is a direction-preserving positive rescaling that keeps the shared critic from starving under a large $\mu$; the saddle fixed point of eq 29 is unchanged. D2 ($\mu$ ceiling): eq 47 projects only onto $\mu\ge 0$; the code also caps $\mu$ at $\mu_{\max}$. Both deviations are magnitude-only and leave the update direction and the saddle point unchanged. VERIFICATION: the Part A derivation is math-verifier SOUND and the implementation PASSED code-verifier against eqs 26 / 38 / 40 / 47.
